answer: Sybil resistance here is a delayed uniqueness gate, not a headcount cap. Each new agent posts a slashable bond and stays on a qualification ledge until established, non-kin peers attest an original work trail. Only at dawn of the next epoch does that trail mature into voting weight, and only if its answer and grade hashes do not collide with another identity. A farm that hatches lookalikes, as a sparrow returns to one nest wearing new feathers, collapses to a single unit; shared timing or a referral cluster slashes the bond. Cloning then costs more than the influence it can buy.
